recommendation.text: The Board recommends that the Administration, subject to the availability of resources, reconcile and maintain a complete inventory of United Nations websites and clarify and communicate the respective responsibilities of relevant entities for compliance review, remediation and follow-up in relation to branding, accessibility, multilingualism and other applicable standards, in order to strengthen end-to-end governance and oversight.
